k:HH.Kitchen.Finishing: a finishing touch (milk, eggs, chocolate, beer, berries or mushrooms)
k:HH.Kitchen.Finishing2: a second finishing touch (beer, berries or mushrooms)
k:HH.Kitchen.Stale: Stale: no Well fed, no mood bonus.
k:HH.Kitchen.Stat.WellDesc: How long hunger falls slower after eating this dish. Scales with learning level and quality.
k:HH.Kitchen.Stat.MoodDesc: Mood bonus from a proper dish, by learning level and quality (stale dishes give none).
k:HH.Kitchen.Cookbook.Title: Colony cookbook
k:HH.Kitchen.Cookbook.UnknownHint: Not learned yet. Research {0}, or find a cookbook.
k:HH.Kitchen.Cookbook.Dark: Hidden: the dark menu is off.
k:HH.Setting.kitchen.shelfLife.Desc: How long plates stay fresh, relative to the 3 to 24 hours of each dish. Stale plates are still edible but give no Well fed and no mood bonus.
k:HH.Setting.kitchen.wellFedStrength.Des: How much slower hunger falls after a proper dish (100 % = 40 % slower).
k:HH.Setting.kitchen.wellFedDuration.Des: How long the Well fed state lasts, relative to 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 hours by learning level (and by quality).
k:HH.Setting.kitchen.menuPrice.Desc: Prices a restaurant asks for dishes, relative to the standard menu (dish level, quality and form).
k:HH.Setting.kitchen.poisonRule: No food poisoning from a good kitchen
k:HH.Setting.kitchen.poisonRule.Desc: Plates cooked by a cook with Cooking 4 or more in a clean kitchen (cleanliness -0.2 or better) can never poison. Off: vanilla rolls apply.
k:HH.Setting.kitchen.variants.Desc: Offer each dish in a Fine form (more and better ingredients, a better chance for good quality) and a Signature form (research needed).
k:HH.Setting.kitchen.allKnown.Desc: Skip learning: every dish of the menu can be cooked as soon as its devices stand.
k:HH.Setting.kitchen.darkMenu.Desc: Allow the long pork dishes. They are also unlocked by an ideoligion that approves of cannibalism.
k:HH.Kitchen.Cookbook.AllKnown: The colony already knows every dish in this book.
k:HH.Kitchen.Cookbook.Learned: {0} studies the book. The colony can now cook: {1}.
k:HH.Kitchen.TestKitchen.Success: {0} worked out how to cook {1}. The colony will remember.
k:HH.Kitchen.TestKitchen.Failure: {0} tried to cook {1} and made a terrible plate of it. Maybe next time.
k:HH.Kitchen.NoNeighbours: No other kitchen device in reach.
d:ThingDef/HH_Cookbook.label: recipe book
d:ThingDef/HH_Cookbook.description: A greasy, dog-eared book of recipes, annotated by someone who clearly cooked under fire. Reading it teaches the colony the dishes it contains.
d:RecipeDef/HH_TestKitchen.label: experiment with a new dish
d:RecipeDef/HH_TestKitchen.description: Throw raw food at the counter and see what comes out. Sometimes the colony works out a new dish (the better the cook, the likelier); otherwise the experiment ends as a terrible plate of that dish.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Campfir: Everything went into the pot, including the argument about what everything meant.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_PotatoS: Tastes like home, if home had a dirt floor and low expectations.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_SpitRoa: Turned by hand for an hour by whoever lost the coin toss.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_HashAnd: A breakfast that says the day will not get better, but will get fried.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_CornPor: Thick enough to patch a wall in an emergency.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_BerryCo: The only thing on the Rim that is both sweet and cheap.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_PlainSt: Rice. It is rice. Please stop looking at the menu for more.
Rice porridge for people who have had a very long week and a very long raid.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_EggDrop: Eggs swirled into hot broth, because the broth needed a hobby.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_RoastCo: Eaten standing up, in the rain, while someone shoots at the stall.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_RoastPo: Golden, crunchy and the closest thing to joy in sector seven.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_MilkRic: Comfort food for colonists whose comfort has been recalled.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Scrambl: Eggs, but rearranged until they stopped complaining.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_BugSkew: Crunchy on the outside and not a lot of questions on the inside.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_RawFish: Sliced by someone who watched a video about it once.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_PanFrie: If it swam yesterday, it fries today.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_AgavePa: Stacked high to hide the fact that there is only one egg.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_FruitBo: Healthy, fresh and gone in four seconds when the children arrive.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Mushroo: Chilled mushrooms, because the fridge was already running.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Crimson: Berries, milk and a secret pink.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_SmokedJ: Lasts forever, which is also how long it takes to chew.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Bratwur: Sausage in a bun, beer in a mug, regret in the morning.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_InsectT: Three tacos, zero questions, and a very good sauce.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_FishAnd: Fried twice for luck and once for spite.
